intro.h2: A Rochester remodeling company you talk to directly
paragraphs: Goldsmith Remodel and Design is a family business offering kitchen remodeling in Rochester, MN and nearby towns. Joe Goldsmith started in the trades young. Today he runs every project himself as owner, project manager and lead carpenter. From the first meeting to the final walkthrough, you deal with the people responsible for the work.

Clients tend to praise the same things. One Google reviewer wrote that the quote was very reasonable and that Joe pivoted without difficulty when she changed the design. Others mention dust barriers, daily cleanup and an estimate that held. Every photo on the company's site is a real job finished by this team.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Rochester, MN and the rest of the house

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Joe breaks a big kitchen project into steps you can manage, from layout and cabinets to counters and lighting. On request, you get a free 3D rendering with your quote. Recent kitchens pair white shaker cabinets with stained wood islands and quartz tops.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with dark stained wood island, built-in microwave drawer, white cabinets, wood range hood and wide-plank floor

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Small hall baths and full primary suites both make the most of the space you have. Past work includes tiled walk-in showers with glass doors, freestanding tubs and double vanities. One Lanesboro client's bathroom project was finished in just two days.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel with freestanding soaking tub, frameless glass walk-in shower, tiled niche and porcelain plank floor

items.name: Basement and Main-Level Remodeling
items.blurb: Turn an unfinished lower level into rooms the family uses every day. One Rochester client's half-framed basement became two bedrooms, a full bath, a laundry room, closets with cabinetry, a family room with an accent wall, and a playroom or office.

image.alt: Finished basement room with navy accent wall and diagonal trim pattern, recessed lights and wood-look vinyl plank floor

items.name: Decks and Enclosed Porches
items.blurb: Add outdoor living space that works in a Minnesota summer. Goldsmith builds new decks and screened or enclosed porches that keep out bugs, rain and extreme temperatures. One Rochester client said their replacement decks drew multiple compliments.

image.alt: Screened porch addition built on posts off the back of a two-story home with green siding

items.name: Windows, Doors and Exteriors
items.blurb: Small exterior changes can give your home a fresh look from the street. Goldsmith replaces windows and doors and updates exteriors, and helps you choose products that suit the house. It is the same owner-led crew that handles the interior work.

image.alt: Front exterior of a split-level home with gray siding, new windows and a shaded front lawn

why_choose_us.h2: What working with Goldsmith is like

items.title: Free 3D design first
items.text: With your quote, you can ask for a free 3D rendering of the new space. You see the layout before demo day, and changes are easy to make on paper.

items.title: Pricing with no surprises
items.text: The detailed estimate shows exactly what your project will cost. A Rochester client wrote that Joe's estimated cost was accurate and helped them stay within budget.

items.title: A clean house each night
items.text: Crews put up dust barriers between the work area and your living space and clean up at the end of each day. Several reviewers mention coming home to a clean house.

items.title: Licensed and insured
items.text: Goldsmith Remodel and Design lists License #BC805216 on its site and is fully insured. Every photo on its site comes from a real job finished by this team.

about.text: Joe Goldsmith started working in the trades at a young age and found he loved building and transforming spaces. He started Goldsmith Remodel and Design in Rochester to give homeowners a better remodeling experience built on honesty, communication and quality work. Joe is still the owner, project manager and lead carpenter on every job. Lexie Goldsmith is the office coordinator and works on design. Carpenter Broc McCabe rounds out the crew. Their values are simple: upfront pricing, doing things the right way rather than the fast way, and treating your home like their own.
about.owner_role: Owner, Project Manager and Lead Carpenter

image.alt: Joe and Lexie Goldsmith of Goldsmith Remodel and Design in Rochester, MN

process.h2: From your first call to the final walkthrough

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Send the contact form or call. Joe's team usually replies within 24 to 48 hours by phone or email to learn about your project.

steps.title: In-home consultation
steps.text: Joe visits your home to talk through ideas, take measurements and get a clear picture of your space, goals and budget.

steps.title: Design and estimate
steps.text: You get a detailed quote and, if you ask, a free 3D rendering. A down payment is due when you accept the estimate and contract.

steps.title: Selections and building
steps.text: The team guides your material choices and writes you a shopping guide. Demo starts when everything arrives, and you hear from Joe throughout.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You and Joe walk the finished room together to make sure every detail meets your expectations before the job is closed out.

service_area.text: Goldsmith Remodel and Design is based in Rochester, MN and works in Rochester and the surrounding area. Client reviews on the company's site come from homeowners in Rochester, Eyota and Lanesboro. Joe meets you at your house for every estimate, so call or send the form to check whether your town is in range. Expect a reply within a day or two.

items.a: Yes. Goldsmith offers a free estimate and, on request, a free 3D design, with no pressure and no obligation. Joe comes to your house, talks through your ideas, takes measurements and then sends a clear plan and a detailed estimate showing exactly what the project will cost.

items.q: Who will actually be working in my home?
items.a: A small, close team. Joe Goldsmith is the owner, project manager and lead carpenter, Lexie Goldsmith is the office coordinator and works on design, and Broc McCabe is the carpenter. You work directly with the owner from the first meeting to the final walkthrough instead of passing through a salesperson.

Goldsmith requires a down payment when you accept the estimate and contract, plus payments at different stages of the project. The detailed estimate lays out the full cost up front. A Rochester client wrote that Joe's estimated project cost was accurate and helped them stay within budget.

items.q: Will my house be a mess during the remodel?
items.a: The crew works to keep the site clean and organized. On one kitchen and primary bath job, Joe put up barriers to keep dust out of the living spaces next door, and the team cleaned up at the end of each day. Other reviewers say their house was left clean throughout.

Yes. The company lists License #BC805216 on its site and states that it is fully insured. It is locally owned and based in Rochester. If you want to see its work first, every photo on the company's site comes from a real job finished by the Goldsmith team.
